description: The app webview's baseline grant. `core:default` is what makes `listen()` work at all — without it the event plugin's commands are denied, every listener registration rejects silently, and a turn runs to completion with nothing on screen. `core:default`'s window half is READ-ONLY (is-maximized, title, monitors, and nothing that acts), so an app-owned title bar has to name every command its controls call: without them the three buttons and dragging the window by the bar reject into a console warning and do nothing at all. SCOPED BY `webviews`, NEVER `windows`: a `windows` entry grants every webview in that window, browser pane included, which would hand `window.__TAURI__` to whatever page is loaded. See `src/browser.rs` and the two tests in it that pin this file.
